title: Plant Manager
text:
**Make a +Difference at Kraton!**
At Kraton, we make a
**+Difference**
, and we are looking for individuals who are also looking to make a difference in their jobs, for our customers and to the world. We are looking to hire a key member of our Operations team at our Belpre, Ohio location.
 
 
The Plant Manager leads safe, efficient, and compliant plant operations while driving Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and workforce development. As the site leader, this role owns annual operating plans, budgets, capital investments, productivity, quality, reliability, and cost performance, using KPI-driven management to improve throughput, labor efficiency, and EBITDA. The Plant Manager ensures compliance with safety and environmental regulations, ISO 9001, Good Manufacturing Practices, customer requirements, and applicable audits, while developing leaders, partnering effectively with union representatives, and collaborating across Commercial, R&D, Finance, IT, Procurement, and Supply Chain.
 
 
We believe in making a
**+Difference,**
as a global manufacturer of sustainable specialty polymers and biobased pine chemicals, delivering innovative, high-performance solutions.
 
 
We’re proud to offer benefits that meaningfully support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.
 
 
**Some Of The Benefits Offered Are**

* Medical Insurance, including TeleDoc - multiple plans available with Flexible Spending Account & Health Savings Account options
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Health Advocate – free support to help you understand your coverage and answer questions
* Life Insurance – base coverage paid for by Kraton with option for additional coverage
* 401k – Kraton provides matching contributions based on enrollment level
* Employee Assistance Program – provided at no cost to employees
* Accident, Disability, and Critical Illness Insurance

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operations Leadership**
Lead the process of developing and executing annual operating plans, Fixed Cost budgets, Capital Expenditures and productivity initiatives.
 
 
Focal point for escalation of safety, environmental, operational, cost, and quality -related issues.
 
 
Clearly communicate to the site the key priorities and objectives of the annual operating plan.
 
 
**Safety & Environmental**
Ensure compliance with all safety and environmental regulations of PSM covered facility.
 
 
Promote a proactive, safety-first culture across the site.
 
 
Maintain audit-ready facility conditions and operational standards for regulatory and management system audits. (OSHA, FRA, USEPA, Coast Guard, Responsible Care, etc.)
 
 
**Quality**
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 management system, customer requirements and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
 
 
Stakeholder for internal and customer audits of the site.
 
 
Drive corrective and preventive actions and continuous quality improvement.
 
 
**Operational Excellence & Execution**
Lead various manufacturing operations and achieve annual business plan.
 
 
Understand key metrics that drive performance across safety, quality, reliability and cost.
 
 
Manage KPI-driven daily management systems.
 
 
Improve throughput, capacity utilization, and operational efficiency.
 
 
Ensure effective maintenance and equipment reliability programs are in place and are consistently being executed.
 
 
**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**
Standardize processes and reduce operational variability.
 
 
Drive measurable continuous improvement tied to financial performance.
 
 
Drive EBITDA improvement through productivity and cost-control initiatives.
 
 
Work with Operations and Maintenance to optimize labor efficiency and staffing models.
 
 
**People & Culture Leadership**
Build, coach, and develop high-performing leadership team.
 
 
Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
 
 
Partner with HR on recruiting, talent development, and succession planning at the site.
 
 
Participate in the performance management process.
 
 
Interact effectively with a union represented workforce and union representatives. Develop a firm knowledge of the site collective bargaining agreement.
 
 
**Required Skills**

* Minimum of 15 years of experience
* A minimum of 5 years in the manufacturing industry (related industry experience should include chemical or other process manufacturing)
* Adequate knowledge of business and management principles (budgeting, strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources)
* Proven managerial experience and strong team building, decision-making and people management skills

**Education, Certifications & Licenses**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering strongly preferred.

**--------------------------------------------------**
*The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this classification. Statements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and skills required for this position.*
*Kraton’s internal talent acquisition team manages our recruiting efforts and from time to time works with pre-selected/pre-approved external staffing agencies. We do NOT accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from recruiters and/or agencies who are not pre-selected/pre-approved.*
*Kraton is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.*
